challenges.title: Design a REST API for a Blog
challenges.prompt: Design the REST endpoints for posts, comments, and tags. Cover resource naming, status codes, nested vs flat resources, filtering/sorting, and error response shape.
challenges.evalRubric: Idempotency of PUT vs POST respected; 2xx/4xx/5xx used correctly; pagination + filtering consistent across collections; error body has a stable machine-readable code; no verbs in URLs.

challenges.title: API Versioning Strategy
challenges.prompt: You have a public API with thousands of integrators. Design a versioning strategy: how versions are selected, how you ship breaking changes, deprecation policy, and how you avoid a version explosion.
requirements: version selector (URL vs header vs date-based)
backfill/transform layer so old versions keep working
challenges.evalRubric: Trade-offs of URL vs header vs pinned-date versioning; server transforms requests/responses to a canonical internal version; additive changes not versioned; Sunset/Deprecation headers; changelog discipline.

challenges.title: Pagination + Filtering Contract
challenges.prompt: Design the pagination and filtering contract for a large collection API used by dashboards and sync jobs. Both need it, but for different reasons.
requirements: cursor pagination for sync, why not offset
filter grammar (field ops: eq, gt, in)
total count: exact vs estimate vs omit
challenges.evalRubric: Cursor is opaque and encodes sort position; filter grammar is extensible and validated; expensive exact counts avoided or opt-in; response includes next_cursor + has_more; consistent across endpoints.

challenges.title: API Authentication & Authorization
challenges.prompt: Design auth for a B2B API: how clients authenticate, how scopes/permissions work, key rotation, and how you protect against leaked credentials.
requirements: API keys vs OAuth client-credentials vs mTLS — pick + justify
key rotation without downtime (multiple active keys)
rate limits + audit log tied to identity
challenges.evalRubric: Auth mechanism matches the consumer (server-to-server); scopes enforced at the edge; two-key rotation window; secret scanning / GitHub token patterns; short-lived tokens where possible; audit trail.

challenges.title: Idempotency & Retry Contract
challenges.prompt: Define the client-server contract for safe retries across your whole API: which methods are idempotent, how Idempotency-Key works, retry guidance, and what the client should do on each failure class.
requirements: retry-on: network error, 5xx, 429 (with backoff); don't retry: 4xx
challenges.evalRubric: Clear method-by-method idempotency table; key scoping (per endpoint/account); Retry-After honored; exponential backoff + jitter recommended to clients; conflict (same key, different body) handling.

challenges.title: Webhook API Contract
challenges.prompt: Design the consumer-facing contract for webhooks: event schema and evolution, signature verification steps, delivery guarantees, ordering, and how consumers should build a reliable receiver.
requirements: event envelope (id, type, created, data, api_version)
ordering not guaranteed — reconcile via API
challenges.evalRubric: Event schema versioned with the API; verification steps unambiguous (raw body, timestamp tolerance); consumer told to be idempotent; replay/backfill endpoint; thin events vs fat events trade-off.
